svg.title: OASIS: the open-source agent for any model (animated)
svg.desc: The OASIS wordmark and tagline beside a terminal window where OASIS fixes a failing login test: it finds the bug, shows a one-line diff, runs npm test with 42 passing, and finishes with a checked summary. Fen, the pixel-art fennec fox mascot, peeks over the terminal.

g.text: Code, research, writing and automation, in the terminal,
web, desktop or chat. Work that is actually checked.
